function.text: MDM2 encodes an E3 ubiquitin ligase and negative regulator of p53, helping control p53 stability and activity. Based in part on similarity, it is an E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase that mediates ubiquitination of p53/TP53, leading to its degradation by the proteasome. It inhibits p53/TP53- and p73/TP73-mediated cell cycle arrest and apoptosis by binding its transcriptional activation domain. It also acts as a ubiquitin ligase E3 toward itself and ARRB1.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MDM2 have been reported in liposarcoma, osteosarcoma, and intimal sarcoma.
